# Heat haze

The shimmer of hot air: the image wobbles in small, rising ripples, strongest near the bottom. Give it a mask to haze only above a fire or a road.

<EffectDemo effect="heat-haze" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { heatHaze } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/heat-haze';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(heatHaze({ preset: 'desert' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.strength = 4`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                                                             |
| ---------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `strength` | number  | `4`     | 0 – 20 px  | How far the haze bends the image.                                       |
| `scale`    | number  | `40`    | 5 – 200 px | Size of the ripples.                                                    |
| `speed`    | number  | `1`     | 0 – 4      | How fast the ripples rise.                                              |
| `rise`     | number  | `0.6`   | 0 – 1      | How much stronger the haze is at the bottom than the top.               |
| `seed`     | integer | `0`     | 0 – 9999   | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                             |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `desert`     | `strength: 8`, `scale: 60`, `speed: 0.8`             |
| `subtle`     | `strength: 2`, `scale: 30`                           |
| `jetExhaust` | `strength: 12`, `scale: 20`, `speed: 3`, `rise: 0`   |
| `mirage`     | `strength: 6`, `scale: 120`, `speed: 0.5`, `rise: 1` |

Apply one with `heatHaze({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Cost:** 9.3 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/heat-haze`, including the shared effect runtime.
